description: Priya Sharma submits formal application for the $2,500 workforce retraining grant through Maria Santos's office. Supporting documentation includes SQL/data visualization course enrollment, three completed modules, and a working query output on commercial fleet incident data. Application requests clarification on whether the 10% auto row threshold applies to individual workers.
expected_outcome: Grant approval of $2,500 to support Priya's transition toward data analyst or commercial fleet risk analytics role.

secondary_communication.description: Priya sends Linda Park a brief professional note asking for any update on the corporate pivot memo. One-sentence ask, no pressure signal. Decision-relevant: if no response by tick 8, Priya begins treating her departure as likely rather than possible.
